summary: A member tests a restriction on holding office against the teacher who would have to quit to serve.
realLife: Robert Short challenged a proposal about public employment and public office by asking what it would mean for a teacher in Wyoming’s part-time legislature.
inGame: needs: the proposed restriction, the office it covers and a relevant employment example.

turns.what: The member asks the sponsor to read the exception aloud.
turns.pulledBy: A revision exempts the job used in the example.
turns.writesBack: The minutes tie the example to the revised wording.

turns.what: The member states the consequence for a working teacher.
turns.pulledBy: The sponsor retains the disputed restriction.
turns.writesBack: The recorded objection travels with the unchanged proposal.
